product_metadata.title: SmartDevil Small Personal USB Desk Fan, 3 Speeds Portable Desktop Table Cooling Fan Powered by USB, Strong Wind, Quiet Operation, for Home Office Car Outdoor Travel (Light Brown)
features: 【Exquisite Design】ONLY 6 oz! Compact lightweight design for maximum convenience. Small and lightweight personal fan provides cooling air circulation in any desired directions with 360 degree tilt rotation.Perfect for use in home,car, office, desktop, camping, or travel.
【Ultra-Quiet】The small usb desk fan uses a silent structure which is engineered to be ultra-quiet while delivering high airflow. Better accompany your work or sleep without disturbing you.

【Three-speed Adjustable】 Low/medium/high speed level. Adjust appropriate fan speed by pressing the power button repeatedly. Third gear which can be variable speed design provides you more choices in different temperature environment.

【High Compatibility USB-powered】The portable desktop fan is powered by USB and compatible with PC/laptop, power bank, AC adapter, car charger and other USB-enabled power supply. This personal fan is energy-saving and environmentally friendly. (Note:This fan does not carry a battery)
